title: eat shit & die 132
author: bpatrick
html: Allison is a character I’ve been thinking about for awhile. I have several story ideas for her but I can’t get to them because it takes so long to make comics. So I’ve been figuring out a way to work her into eat shit & die which are shorter. She starts out on a down note here but I think she’ll give some comics a more positive feel eventually.

comments.author: Foxhat
comments.html:
I must say your comic is one of the best on the web.

But that one sure dragged my mood down.

comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html: Don’t worry, he says it’s going to get happier, we’ll have to wait and see.

comments.author: speearr
comments.html:
At some point between childhood and adulthood, we lose that optimism. She probably won’t find it again until she’s senile….
Hey her skirt vanishes in the last panel! 😉

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.html: I just wanna say i appreciate comix that actually have background art in them. You always deliver in that regard, I’ll say that. Oh, and when I was reading this i was coincidentally listening to the song “every day is exactly the same,” so that was, uh, unnerving, especially in panel eight there.

comments.author: bpatrick
comments.html: Thanks, Winston! Not as detailed and packed with hilarious jokes as yours but I guess they’re all right.

comments.author: Standard
comments.html: I don’t think these comic could put you down if you’re already down. I just relate to most and sadly laugh at them all (sucks being happy for a change)

comments.author: Simim
comments.html: When you lose that optimism, that’s when you know you’ve grown up. Some people never grow up, and those people are the coolest fuckers to ever exist on the planet.
